_comment: OVERRIDE. This file sits at simplemagnets' OWN recipe id, which is how an override works and
also how it fails: load order decides who wins and the loser is silent. Landing it at the wrong
id would not override anything - it would add a second recipe with the same grid, one of them
dead, with no error. Nothing automated catches that, here or in Recompile.
Moved out of Recompile into the pack on 2026-09-08 (trashlands#47), where re-theming another
mod's recipes belongs. Recompile shipped an identical copy through 0.20.0 and deleted it in
0.21.0, so this is the only one. KubeJS data outranks mod data, so it beats the stock recipe.
As the basic coil, one tier up.
